versions.subject: Add files via upload
versions.detection:
description: Add more office applications to the rule logic of choice
selection1:
  EventLog: Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational
  EventID: 1
selection2:
  - Image: '\wbem\WMIC.exe'
  - CommandLine: '*wmic *'
  - OriginalFileName: 'wmic.exe'
  - Description: 'WMI Commandline Utility'
selection3:
  - ParentPrcessName|endswith:
    - winword.exe
    - excel.exe
    - powerpnt.exe
condition: selection1 AND selection2 AND selection3
versions.spl: EventLog="Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" EventID=1 Image="\\wbem\\WMIC.exe" OR CommandLine="*wmic *" OR OriginalFileName="wmic.exe" OR Description="WMI Commandline Utility" ParentPrcessName IN ("*winword.exe", "*excel.exe", "*powerpnt.exe")
